comments.body: I am at the program, what do u want to know? If u r talking about the research assistant positions, u can find one. If u have a solid programming background its not a problem. Justbask around and ask the professor u want to work with. I can only speak for the transportation systems institute though. No idea what's going on in other parts. There are not so many openings, but the program is also ca. 30 people, so... its manageable. Anyway, hope its what u needed to know :)
comments.author: OleksandrHalipchak
